audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3 read Skill while whys[2] says concede the level; Level 6 read Skill while whys[4] says you own that window outright; first item and 2+ items read Darius while whys[5] and whys[6] both call them coin-flips.
audit.why: Four rows contradicted their own why cells. The packet levelChart (Darius x4 / Mordekaiser / Skill / Skill) matches every why exactly.
audit.corrected: Chart set to the packet read in matched full+content pairs, ratings rescaled, and phases[2], [5] and [6] why-text rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Apprehend was the tracked cooldown on eleven surfaces and its duration never appeared; breakdown.cooldowns listed it twice, once as "Apprehend (Pull)" and once plainly.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 — the longest cooldown in his kit and by far the biggest punish window in the lane. Without the number, "engage when it is down" is unactionable.
audit.corrected: Apprehend written as 26s at rank 1 and 535 range in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[2].d and report[5].t; Decimate as 9s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent from the ability surfaces: only Decimate’s outer blade heals him (the handle does not), and Hemorrhage stacks to five with each stack increasing Noxian Guillotine’s true damage.
audit.why: Riot’s Q text says he heals based on champions hit by the blade; the R text says the damage is increased for each stack of Hemorrhage.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns state the blade-versus-handle heal, dontsFull[1].d states the five-stack execute scaling, and report[8].t adds Grievous Wounds for the blade heal.

edits.before: Full kit plus Darkness Rise — three hits sets your aura burning and the lane flips. E-drag Darius off his wave and run the Q-auto-E pattern on every Apprehend (Pull) cooldown.
edits.after: Darkness Rise needs three hits to light, and Apprehend's slow plus five Hemorrhage stacks beats your short trades before it ramps. Concede and W-heal the chip.

edits.before: Liandry's makes Darkness Rise melt through bruiser HP stacking. Extended trades are now strictly yours — force them.
edits.after: Liandry's makes the all-in lethal, but Stridebreaker and his R execute spike just as hard — whoever commits first wins.

edits.before: Riftmaker omnivamp turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable into most matchups. Darius's only outs are dodging Q forever or never being alone — neither survives a whole game.
edits.after: At even items the first engage decides it: your E-pull into the aura grind against his slow into five bleed and the R execute. Genuinely a coin-flip.

edits.before: - Darius Apprehend (Pull): matchup-defining — His all-in starts on the pull. Don’t get caught. Track it before every engage. - Darius Apprehend: Pulls all enemies in a cone toward him and grants armor pen — his engage. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Darius Apprehend: matchup-defining — 26s at rank 1 and only 535 range; his whole all-in starts on it, so step up the moment it is spent. - Darius Decimate: 9s, and only the outer blade heals him — stand inside the handle.

edits.before: His all-in starts on the pull. Don’t get caught. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It is 26s at rank 1 and reaches only 535 units. Step up the moment he whiffs it.

edits.before: That is Darius's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Decimate's outer blade heals him and only the blade — the handle does not.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Hemorrhage stacks five times and each one feeds the true damage on his R.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 — eat it and his whole combo lands, dodge it and you have a full 26-second window to run your whole pattern for free.

edits.before: Track Darius's Apprehend (Pull): His all-in starts on the pull. Don’t get caught. When it is down — E him in and Q-isolate.
edits.after: Apprehend: 26s at rank 1 and only 535 range, and his whole all-in starts on it. When it is spent — E him in and Q-isolate.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion. Core: Liandry's Torment  (burn carries his extended trades), then Riftmaker; boots Plated Steelcaps. First back: Lost Chapter component / Bami's (≈900-1300g).
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion. Core: Liandry's Torment, then Riftmaker, plus Grievous Wounds — only Decimate's outer blade heals him; boots Plated Steelcaps. First back: Bami's (≈900-1300g).

notes: Not asserted: Apprehend carries a derived knockup flag that Riot’s description does not support (it sweeps enemies up and pulls them to him), so everything I wrote calls it a pull — the same call the darius-side audit made. Mordekaiser Q’s derived grounding flag likewise not asserted. The resistances-invalidated missing-interaction is real (Noxian Guillotine is true damage) and the page already carries it in whys[6], spikes[3] and late, so I did not duplicate it.
